items.lede: Megaspeed, which was previously led by Alice Huang, would be barred from doing business with U.S. companies unless those companies attained a special license from the federal government.

items.lede: As Jensen Huang returns to his post as Nvidia's CEO with support from the Trump administration, the Department of Commerce has added Megaspeed to its Entity List, which blocks trade with the company, citing national security risks.
